DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便の差出しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you posting a letter?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この手紙を出すつもりでしたが、清書と下書きのどちらを入れたか思い出せません。まだお渡ししていないので、今日は一度持ち帰って確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 清書か下書きか入れた内容が不明で未引渡し封筒を持帰って確認したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I intended to send this letter, but can't remember whether I put in the final copy or the draft. I haven't handed it over yet, so I'd like to take it home today and check.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you are unsure whether the envelope contains the final copy or draft and want to take it home before handing it over.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中身が違うかもしれないのですね。こちらで内容が正しいかを判断することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: The contents might be different, then. We cannot judge here whether the contents are correct.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。机には下書きが残っていましたが、それだけで清書を封筒へ入れたと確実には言えません。二枚とも机にあった時間があるからです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 机に残る下書きだけでは封筒内が清書とは断定できず両方机にあったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. The draft was left on my desk, but that alone doesn't prove I put the final copy in the envelope, because both were on the desk at one point.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that a draft remaining on the desk does not prove the final copy is inside because both were on the desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自身で中身を確認してから差し出してください。封筒の包装も、その際に整えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the contents yourself before posting. Please also put the envelope packaging in order at that time.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家で確認します。封を開けた後に同じ封筒を使えるかは、破れ方や閉じ方も見て相談します。今日のまま確認済みとして発送しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家で実物確認し開封後の封筒再使用は状態も相談するため今は発送しないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check at home. After opening it, I'll ask whether I can reuse the same envelope based on how it tears and closes. Please don't send it now as if it has been checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check the actual contents at home, ask about reusing the opened envelope based on its condition, and request no dispatch now.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まだお預かりしていませんので、お持ち帰りください。急ぎの期限はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We haven't accepted it yet, so please take it home. Is there an urgent deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明日出せればよいと考えていますが、届く日の保証を今求めているわけではありません。中身が正しいことを確かめてから、必要な到着時期も相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 明日差出し予定だが到着保証依頼ではなく内容確認後に到着希望を相談すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm thinking it would be fine to post tomorrow, but I'm not asking for a guaranteed arrival date now. After checking the contents are right, I'll ask about the needed arrival time too.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you plan to post tomorrow but are not requesting guaranteed delivery, and will discuss desired arrival after checking the contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 中身と包装を整えてから、差出し方法をご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After putting the contents and packaging in order, please ask about the posting method.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日はこの封筒を持ち帰ります。清書かどうかを実物で確認し、封筒を整えて、到着の希望をあわせて相談してから差し出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は持帰り清書確認と包装準備をして到着希望と発送方法を相談後差し出すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take this envelope home today. I'll check the final copy itself, prepare the envelope, and post after discussing my desired arrival time and the mailing method.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will take it home, verify the final copy and packaging, then discuss arrival wishes and dispatch before posting.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。確認後に、発送について改めてご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please consult us again about sending after you've checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。本日はどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about today?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 登録した電話番号を変えたいです。相談用のメモを用意しましたが、暗証番号まで書いてしまったので、このままお見せせず用件だけ伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 登録電話番号を変えたいが暗証番号も書いた相談メモをそのまま見せず用件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to change my registered phone number. I prepared a note for the consultation but wrote my PIN too, so I want to explain the purpose without showing the note as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want to change your registered phone number without showing a consultation note that also contains your PIN.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 暗証番号を見せたり読み上げたりする必要はありません。メモをほかの方へ渡してはいませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You don't need to show or read your PIN aloud. Have you given the note to anyone else?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ誰にも渡していません。待つ間も机の上へ広げず、自分で持っていました。ここでは登録電話番号の変更について話したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: メモは未引渡しで待機中も広げず保持し連絡先変更の相談と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not to anyone yet. While waiting, I kept it with me rather than spreading it on the table. Here I'd like to discuss changing my registered phone number.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you have not handed over or displayed the note and your inquiry concerns changing contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 変更の手続きと本人確認について担当がご案内します。新しい連絡先は、今使える番号ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: The adviser will explain the change procedure and identity checks. Is the new contact number one you can use now?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、今使っている番号です。暗証番号が見えるメモを確認資料にするのではなく、必要な番号だけを指定された方法で伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新番号は使用中で暗証番号入り紙を資料にせず必要な番号だけ指定方法で伝えたいと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, it's the number I use now. Rather than use the note showing my PIN as supporting material, I'd like to give only the necessary number by the specified method.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the new number is in use and you want to provide only necessary numbers by the designated method without presenting the PIN sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当の案内に従ってご記入ください。メモの私的な情報は、ご自身で管理してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please fill in the details as directed by the adviser. Manage the private information on your note yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 元のメモは自分でしまいます。新しく相談内容だけを書き直し、本人確認書類は何を用意すればよいか担当へ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元メモは自分でしまい用件だけ書き直し必要な本人確認書類を担当へ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll put the original note away myself. I'd like to rewrite only the inquiry details and ask the adviser what identification documents to prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will put away the original, rewrite only the purpose, and ask staff about necessary identification.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご案内します。手続きが済んだかどうかも、担当からの確認を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll direct you. Please also get confirmation from the adviser about whether the procedure has finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 暗証番号入りのメモは渡さず、電話番号変更の用件だけを伝えます。必要書類と記入方法を確かめ、受付で話しただけで変更済みと思わず完了の確認を受けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 私的番号の紙を渡さず変更方法と必要書類を確認し受付相談だけで完了とせず完了確認を受けると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't hand over the note containing my PIN, only explain the phone-number change. I'll check the documents and entry method, and confirm completion rather than assume talking at reception means it is changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not hand over the private-number sheet, will check methods and documents, and obtain completion confirmation beyond the initial inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。連絡先変更を担当する窓口へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll show you to the counter responsible for contact changes.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園の利用についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like advice about using the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語の授業で、公園の好きな場所を来園者に聞く課題があります。知らない方に声をかける前に、こちらで相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 授業の課題で知らない来園者に質問する活動を始める前に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: For Japanese class, we have an assignment to ask visitors their favorite place in the park. I'd like to consult you before approaching people I don't know.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want advice before beginning a class assignment asking unfamiliar park visitors questions.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 授業のお友達同士で話すのではなく、来園者に協力をお願いする予定なのですね。何人で、どのように行う予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: So you plan to ask visitors for cooperation, rather than talk among classmates. How many of you, and how do you plan to do it?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 学生二人で、協力してくれる方に三つ質問する予定です。名前や連絡先は聞かず、回答を短いメモにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 学生二人で三問を尋ね名前や連絡先を集めず回答メモを取る計画を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two students plan to ask willing people three questions. We won't ask names or contact details; we'll take brief notes of answers.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese a plan for two students and three questions, taking answer notes without collecting names or contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 予定の内容を管理担当へ伝えます。掲示物を置いたり、通路に立って人を集めたりする計画はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll tell management your plan. Do you plan to place notices or stand in the passage and gather people?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 看板は置きません。ただ、入口で声をかけようと思っていました。通行の邪魔になる場所は避けたいので、場所も含めて相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 看板は置かないが入口で声をかける予定だったため通行を妨げない場所も相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: We won't put up a sign. However, we planned to speak to people at the entrance. We want to avoid obstructing passage, so will discuss the location too.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not place signs but planned to approach people at the entrance, so want advice on a place that doesn't obstruct passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 場所を先に決めず、質問内容と予定の時間をまとめて担当へご相談ください。今日すぐに始める必要はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Rather than decide the place first, organize the questions and planned time and consult management. Do you need to begin immediately today?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 授業の提出は来週なので、今日は始めません。断られた方に重ねてお願いしないことも、実施案に書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 提出は来週なので今日は実施せず協力を断られた人へ再依頼しない方針を案に含める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The class deadline is next week, so we won't start today. We'll also include in our plan that we won't ask again if someone declines.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the deadline is next week, so you will not start today and will include a policy not to repeat requests to people who decline.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。実施案をお持ちいただくか、担当の相談先へご連絡ください。相談先のメモをお渡ししましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please bring your plan or contact the management consultation point. Shall I give you a note of their contact details?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。質問三つと二人の役割、予定の時間をまとめてから連絡します。案内を聞いただけで実施できると決めず、担当の返答を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談先のメモを受け取り質問役割時間を整理して管理担当の返答を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please. We'll organize the three questions, our two roles and the planned time, then contact them. We won't assume this guidance alone permits the activity; we'll await their response.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept the contact note in Japanese and say you will organize questions, roles and timing and wait for management's response.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 公園の管理担当への相談先を書いたメモをお渡しします。授業の実施案を整理してお問い合わせください。活動の実施については担当の返答をお待ちください。事前にご相談くださり、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is a note with the park management contact. Please organize the class activity plan and ask them. Wait for their response about carrying out the activity. Thank you for consulting beforehand.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どうされましたか。何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-01.translation: What's the matter? Is something wrong?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 脱衣所に置いた自分の電話で、設定したアラームが鳴っていると思います。一度荷物の所へ戻って止めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 脱衣所の自分の電話のアラームが鳴っていると思い荷物へ戻って止めたいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-02.translation: I think an alarm I set is ringing on my phone left in the changing room. I'd like to go back to my belongings and stop it.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you think your own changing-room phone alarm is ringing and want to return to your belongings to stop it.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お客様の荷物はどこにありますか。今、音がしている場所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where are your belongings? Do you know where the sound is coming from now?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 奥の棚に置いた青い袋です。朝の予定を変えたのにアラームを消し忘れました。同じ音が繰り返し聞こえています。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 奥の青い袋と予定変更後に消し忘れた繰り返しのアラームを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-04.translation: The blue bag on the shelf at the back. I changed my morning plans but forgot to turn off the alarm. I can hear the same sound repeating.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese the blue bag at the back and the repeating alarm you forgot to cancel after changing plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご自分の荷物と電話を確認し、ほかの方の袋は開けないでください。戻るには、受付の後ろの通路をまっすぐ進み、右側の脱衣所へ入ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check your own belongings and phone, and don't open others' bags. To return, go straight along the passage behind reception and enter the changing room on the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の青い袋の中だけ確かめます。違う電話の音だった場合は、ほかの荷物を探さず係の方に知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の袋だけ確認し別の電話なら他人の荷物を探さず係へ知らせると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll check only inside my own blue bag. If it's another phone making the sound, I won't search other belongings; I'll notify staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check only your bag and notify staff if it is another phone, without searching others' belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お願いします。電話を持って来る必要はありませんが、設定を止めたか確認してからお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do. You don't need to bring your phone back, but check you've stopped the alarm setting before returning.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: アラームを止めるだけでなく、今日はもう鳴らないか予定の設定も見ます。通話をするつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 音を止めた後も今日の設定を見直し通話目的ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll not only stop the sound but also check the schedule settings so it doesn't ring again today. I don't intend to make a call.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will review today's settings after silencing the alarm and that your purpose is not a phone call.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。荷物を確認した後は、電話をしまってからこちらへお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. After checking your belongings, put the phone away before coming back here.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 受付の後ろをまっすぐ進んで、右の脱衣所ですね。自分の電話の音を止めて設定を確認し、袋にしまって戻ります。案内ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付後ろの通路を直進し右の脱衣所へ戻る道を確認し自分の電話を止め設定を見て袋に戻すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-10.translation: Straight behind reception, then the changing room on the right. I'll stop my own phone, check the settings, put it in the bag and return. Thank you for the directions.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the route straight behind reception to the right-hand changing room, and say you will silence, check and re-bag your phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、受付の後ろの通路から右側の脱衣所へお進みください。別の方の電話の音だった場合は、ほかの荷物を探さず係へお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-09-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, take the passage behind reception to the changing room on the right. If the sound belongs to someone else's phone, notify staff without searching other belongings.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。行事のお申し込みについて何かお手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with applying for the event?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族の申込をしたいです。この名前は漢字だけだと別の読み方をされるので、ふりがなも一緒にお伝えしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 漢字だけでは別の読み方になる家族の行事申込にふりがなも伝えたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to register a family member. These kanji can be read differently, so I'd like to provide the furigana pronunciation too.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to include furigana when registering a family member whose kanji name can have another reading.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 承知しました。参加するご本人のお名前ですか。それとも、申し込みをするお客様のお名前ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-03.translation: Understood. Is it the participant's name or your name as the person applying?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 参加する弟の名前です。私は連絡をする人として別の欄に書きます。弟の読み方は「あきら」です。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 参加者は弟で自分は連絡する人として別欄に書き弟の読みはあきらと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-04.translation: My younger brother's name as the participant. I'll write myself separately as the contact person. His name is pronounced “Akira.”
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that your younger brother is the participant, you are the separate contact, and his name reads Akira.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 参加者のお名前の横に、その読み方をご記入ください。呼び出すときも「あきら」でよろしいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please write that reading beside the participant's name. We should use “Akira” when calling him too, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。「あきら」でお願いします。漢字から別の読み方を推測せず、このふりがなを使っていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 呼び出しはあきらとし漢字から推測せずふりがなを使ってほしいと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, Akira, please. I'd like you to use this furigana rather than guess another reading from the kanji.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that he should be called Akira using the furigana rather than guessing from kanji.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認しました。参加者欄と連絡する方の欄が入れ替わっていないか、最後にご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-07.translation: Confirmed. At the end, please check the participant and contact-person fields haven't been switched.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 参加者は弟、連絡先は私になっています。弟本人にもこの書き方を確認してもらってから提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 参加者と連絡者の欄が正しいことを確認し弟本人にも書き方を確認すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-08.translation: The participant is my brother and the contact is me. I'll also have him check this spelling before submitting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese the participant and contact fields are correct and say you will ask your brother to check the wording too.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ち帰りになるのですね。提出前に読み方などが変わった場合は、書き直した用紙をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-09.translation: So you're taking it home. If the reading or other details change before submission, please show the rewritten form.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は用紙を持ち帰ります。弟に確認して、読み方と連絡する人の欄をそろえてから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今日は用紙を持ち帰り本人確認後に名前の読みと連絡者の欄を整えて申し込むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the form home today. After checking with my brother, I'll align the name reading and contact-person fields and apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will take the form home and apply after checking the person, name reading and contact fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人との確認後にお持ちください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-10-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please bring it after confirming with him. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。本日はどのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to ask about today?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 町内会で交通安全の話を聞く会を考えています。講師をお願いできるか、相談先を教えていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 町内会の交通安全講話の講師を頼めるか相談先を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: Our neighborhood association is considering a traffic-safety talk. I'd like contact details to ask whether we can request a speaker.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the contact to discuss requesting a speaker for a neighborhood traffic-safety talk.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 講師についてのご相談ですね。こちらの施設で会場を借りたいというご依頼ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: An inquiry about a speaker, then. Are you requesting a room at this facility as the venue?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会場は町内の集会室を考えています。部屋を借りる依頼ではなく、その会場でお話しいただける方の相談です。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会場は町内集会室で施設の部屋の貸出でなく講師の相談と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: We're considering the neighborhood meeting room. I'm not requesting a room rental, but asking about someone to speak at that venue.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the venue is the neighborhood meeting room and the inquiry is about a speaker, not renting this facility.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。参加する方の年齢や、聞きたい内容は決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Have you decided the participants' ages and the topics you want?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小学生と保護者が対象です。車の運転の話より、通学の時に道路を渡る場面など、歩く時の話を希望しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小学生と保護者向けに運転より通学時の道路横断など歩行の話を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: Elementary school pupils and their parents. Rather than driving, we'd like pedestrian topics such as crossing roads on the way to school.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you want pedestrian safety for pupils and parents, such as crossing roads to school, rather than driving topics.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 対象と内容を担当へ伝えます。開催する日は、すでに決まっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll tell the person responsible the audience and topic. Is the date already fixed?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 候補日は二つありますが、まだ会場も正式に予約していません。先に日程を決めたとお伝えせず、相談の段階だと説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 候補日は二つだが会場も未予約で開催決定でなく相談段階と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: We have two candidate dates, but haven't formally booked the venue either. I'll explain we're at the consultation stage rather than say the date is settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that there are two candidate dates but the venue is not booked and the event is only being discussed.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず、候補日と人数の見込みを整理して担当へお問い合わせください。この受付で講師の手配を確約するものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: First, organize the candidate dates and estimated attendance and contact the adviser. This reception does not guarantee a speaker arrangement.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。町内会で人数と候補日をまとめてから担当へ連絡します。今日の案内だけで講師が決まったとはせず、返答を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 人数と候補日を町内会でまとめ担当へ連絡し講師決定とせず返答を待つと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. We'll organize numbers and dates in the neighborhood association and contact them. We won't treat today's guidance as a confirmed speaker; we'll wait for the reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the association will organize numbers and dates, contact the adviser and wait without assuming a speaker is arranged.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 講師の相談担当への問い合わせ先をお渡しします。町内会で候補日と人数をまとめてからご連絡ください。講師の手配はまだ決まっていません。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll give you the speaker inquiry contact. Please contact them after organizing candidate dates and attendance with the association. A speaker has not been arranged yet. Thank you for asking.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お薬についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Would you like advice about medicine?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日、家族二人の薬を受け取って同じ手提げに入れました。どちらの袋か迷ったので、名前を一緒に確認してもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族二人分を同じ手提げに入れて持ち主に迷い薬袋の名前を一緒に確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: Today I collected medicines for two family members and put them in the same carry bag. I'm unsure whose package is whose, so I'd like you to check the names with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check the names on two family members' medicine bags mixed in one carry bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋は開けたり、中身を別の袋へ移したりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you opened the bags or moved the contents to other bags?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: どちらも開けていません。先に受け取った方が母の袋だと思いましたが、入れた順番は覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未開封で先に受け取った方が母と思ったが収納順は覚えていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Neither is opened. I thought the one received first was my mother's, but don't remember the order I put them in.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that both are unopened and although you thought the first received was your mother's, you don't remember their packing order.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受け取った順ではなく、袋の記載を薬剤師と確認しましょう。二人のお名前を担当にお伝えいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the bag labels with the pharmacist rather than receipt order. Can you tell staff both names?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。母の名前と私の名前をそれぞれ伝えます。薬の見た目が似ていても、自分で入れ替えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母と自分の名前を担当へ伝え見た目が似ていても薬を入れ替えないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'll give my mother's name and my own separately. Even if the medicines look similar, I won't swap them myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will give your mother's and your names and won't swap medicines even if they look alike.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当をお呼びします。ご自宅では、二人分をどのように置く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll call the staff. How do you plan to keep both people's medicines at home?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認が終わったら、袋ごと別々のかごに置きます。中身だけを出して、誰の分か分からなくなる置き方はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認後は袋ごと別のかごに置き中身だけ出して持ち主を不明にしないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: After checking, I'll put the complete bags in separate baskets. I won't take out just the contents and store them in a way that loses whose they are.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that after checking you will keep the bags in separate baskets, without removing contents and losing ownership identification.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 飲み方に関する確認も、袋の持ち主を確かめてから薬剤師へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the pharmacist about directions for taking them after confirming which bag belongs to whom too.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。名前と袋を照合してから、それぞれの飲み方を確認します。順番で決めず、記載が読めない時も薬剤師に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名前と袋の照合後に各人の飲み方を薬剤師へ確認し読めない記載も推測しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll compare the names and bags before checking each person's directions. I won't decide by order, and will ask the pharmacist if any label is unreadable.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will confirm names and bags before each person's dosage instructions and ask the pharmacist rather than guess unreadable details.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。未開封の二つの袋を、そのまま担当にお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please show the two unopened bags to the pharmacist as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。気になるお洋服はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Are there any clothes you're interested in?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このマネキンの上着の形が好きです。腰が細くなっていますが、同じ上着なら着た時もこの形になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: マネキンの細い腰の形が同じ上着を着た時も出るのか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: I like the shape of this mannequin's jacket. The waist is narrow; if I wear the same jacket, will it have this shape too?
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether the mannequin's narrow waist shape will also appear when wearing the same jacket.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 展示では背中を仮留めして、マネキンに合わせています。商品の形そのものとは少し違います。留めていない物をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: For the display, we've temporarily pinned the back to fit the mannequin. It's a little different from the product's actual shape. Would you like to see an unpinned one?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。背中を留めているとは気付きませんでした。仮留めを外した時の腰の幅を見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 背中の仮留めを知り留めていない商品の腰の幅を見たいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, please. I hadn't noticed the back was pinned. I'd like to see the waist width when it isn't pinned.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to see the unpinned product's waist width after learning the display back is pinned.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらが同じ商品の上着です。腰を絞る調整ひもはなく、この幅になります。普段着る服の上から試しますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here is the same jacket. It has no waist drawstring, so this is its width. Would you try it over the clothes you normally wear?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。普段の薄いセーターの上に着たいです。自分でも背中を留めて使うつもりはないので、そのままの形で試します。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薄いセーターの上に着て背中を留めず本来の形で試すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I'd like it over my usual thin sweater. I don't intend to pin the back myself while wearing it, so I'll try its natural shape.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will try the original unpinned shape over a thin sweater.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞお試しください。前を閉めた状態と開けた状態もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please try it on. Look at both how it is when fastened and when open.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 前を閉めると思ったよりゆったりしていますね。展示と同じ細さが必要か考えたいので、今日は買わずに検討します。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 前を閉めた幅が予想よりゆったりなので今日は買わず形を検討すると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Fastened, it's looser than I expected. I'd like to consider whether I need the display's slimness, so I won't buy it today.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the fastened width is looser than expected, so you will consider the shape without buying today.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。試着した上着はこちらへお返しください。商品番号を控えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please return the jacket you tried here. Would you like to note the product number?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号だけ控えさせてください。マネキンの写真だけで形を判断せず、今日試した幅も覚えておきます。上着はお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号を控え写真だけで形を判断せず試着幅も覚えて上着を返すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: Just the number, please. I won't judge the shape from the mannequin photo alone; I'll also remember the width I tried today. I'll return the jacket.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will note the number, remember the tried-on width rather than judge from the photo alone, and return the jacket.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 商品番号はA214です。展示の仮留めを外した形と、セーターの上から試した幅を見てご検討ください。上着をお返しいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: The product number is A214. Please consider the shape without display pins and the width tried over your sweater. Thank you for returning the jacket.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: フロントでございます。何かご希望はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the front desk. Is there anything you would like?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 明日の朝は自然な明るさで起きたいので、部屋のカーテンを少し開けておきたいです。今日の清掃の後も、今の開き方を残してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 朝の明るさで起きるため厚いカーテンを少し開け清掃後も今の状態を残してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to wake with natural light tomorrow morning, so I want to leave the room curtain slightly open. After today's cleaning, could you keep its current opening?
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese for the thick curtain to remain slightly open after cleaning so morning light can help you wake.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 厚い遮光カーテンと薄いカーテンがあります。どちらを開けておきたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a thick blackout curtain and a thin curtain. Which do you want left open?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 厚い方だけ、窓の端を少し開けたいです。薄い方は閉めておきます。外から見えるように全部開けたいわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 厚い方の端だけ開け薄い方は閉めて全面を開ける希望ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only the thick one, a little at the window's edge. I'll keep the thin one closed. I'm not asking to open everything so people outside can see in.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that only the thick curtain edge should open, the thin stays closed, and you do not want everything fully open.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。清掃担当へ希望を伝えますが、開ける幅はどのくらいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. I'll tell housekeeping your request; about how wide should the opening be?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二十センチくらいです。今その幅にしてあるので、位置を動かす必要があれば、清掃後に同じくらい戻してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今の約二十センチの開き幅を動かした場合も清掃後に戻してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: About twenty centimetres. It's at that width now, so if they need to move it, I'd like it returned to about the same after cleaning.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the current opening is about twenty centimetres and you want it restored after cleaning if moved.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当に確認します。夜もそのままにする予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check with the staff. Do you plan to leave it like that at night too?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 寝る直前に自分で調整します。夜は光が気になるかもしれないので、朝のために必ず開けたままにするかは、部屋で決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 寝る直前は自分で光を見て調整し開けたままにするか室内で決めると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll adjust it myself just before bed. Light may bother me at night, so I'll decide in the room whether to leave it open for morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will adjust it yourself before bed based on the light and decide in the room whether to keep it open.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。清掃担当への希望は、厚い方を約二十センチ開け、薄い方は閉める、という内容ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Your request to housekeeping is the thick curtain open about twenty centimetres and the thin curtain closed, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。その内容でお願いします。起きる時間の保証をお願いするものではないので、必要なアラームは自分でも設定します。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 厚い方約二十センチ薄い方閉で取次ぎを頼み起床保証ではなくアラームも自分で設定すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, please pass on that request. I'm not asking for a guarantee of waking at a particular time, so I'll set any needed alarm myself too.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to pass on thick open twenty centimetres and thin closed, explaining this is not a wake-up guarantee and you will set your alarm too.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へ伝え、対応の確認が取れましたらご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll tell the staff and let you know once their response is confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。兜の体験で何かお困りのことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is anything wrong with the helmet experience?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真を撮るつもりでしたが、兜を着けると首を回しにくいです。撮影はいったん止めて、外したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 兜で首を回しづらいため写真を中断して外したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I intended to take photos, but wearing the samurai helmet makes it difficult to turn my neck. I'd like to stop the photography and take it off.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that the helmet makes neck movement difficult, so you want to pause photos and remove it.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのまま首を無理に動かさず、お待ちください。今、痛みはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please wait without forcing your neck to move. Are you in pain now?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 痛みはありませんが、思ったより重く感じます。写真のために我慢せず、この体験は終わりにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 痛みはないが重く感じ写真のため我慢せず体験を終えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: No pain, but it feels heavier than I expected. Rather than endure it for photos, I'll finish the experience.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that there is no pain but it feels heavy, and you will end the experience without enduring it for photographs.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分かりました。係が支えて外しますので、あごのひもを自分で強く引かないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Staff will support and remove it, so don't pull the chin cord hard yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。ひもを引かず、こちらで待ちます。友人にも、まだ撮影を再開しないよう伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分であごひもを引かず係を待ち友人にも撮影を再開しないよう伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'll wait here without pulling the cord. I'll also tell my friend not to restart photographing yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait for staff without pulling the chin cord and tell your friend not to resume photographs.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 外しました。立ち上がる前に、今の状態を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: It's off now. Before standing, please tell me how you feel.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外すと首は動かしやすくなりました。しばらく座ってから移動します。別の兜を試すのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外すと動きやすくなったが座ってから移動し別の兜は試さないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: My neck is easier to move after removing it. I'll sit for a while before moving. I won't try another helmet.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that movement is easier after removal, but you will sit before leaving and not try another helmet.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。兜はこちらで片付けます。お荷物はお手元にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll put the helmet away. Do you have your belongings with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: かばんと電話は手元にあります。落ち着いてから友人と移動します。撮影を急がず対応してくださって、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: かばんと電話は手元にあり落ち着いて友人と移動すると答え対応に礼を言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: My bag and phone are with me. I'll move with my friend after settling down. Thank you for helping without rushing the photographs.
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your bag and phone are with you, you will move with your friend once settled, and thank staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。お忘れ物に気を付け、無理をせずお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-007-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please watch for forgotten belongings and don't overdo it.
